entry.title: dotnet/efcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-01-13
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • [dnceng-bot] Branch `efcore/main` can't be mirrored to Azdo fast forward branch #37500
  • GO batch separator not recognized when block comment contains a single quote #37494

Closed

  • Set up CI testing against SQL Server 2025 #36382
    11.0.0
  • Can no longer translate operators over primitive collections or complex types on inheritance subtypes #37478
    10.0.3

PullRequests

Created

  • Fix materialization of required complex types with all-nullable properties via LEFT JOIN #37495

Merged

  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/8.0' => 'release/9.0' #37504
  • Stop using env in copilot-setup-steps.yml #37505
  • [release/10.0] [tell mode] Add network isolation policy to pipeline settings for release/10 #37498
    tell-mode
  • Merging internal commits for release/9.0 #37502
  • Merging internal commits for release/8.0 #37503
  • Add SQL Server testing on Github Actions #37501
  • Fix copilot-setup-steps.yml #37499
  • Fix primitive/complex collection handling on subtypes #37482
  • [release/10.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #37493
  • Fix copilot-setup-steps.yml #37497
  • Add Github Copilot setup steps for SQL Server #37496

Updated

  • Add support for BigInteger, Int128, and UInt128 in SqliteValueBinder #37492
    community-contribution
  • Fix NullReferenceException when accessing null complex properties in TPH with shared columns #37389
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0' => 'main' #37491
  • Implement EF.Functions.JsonExists #37477
  • Feature/translate json functions #29306 #30010
    community-contribution
  • Add runtime migration creation and application #37415
    community-contribution
  • Cosmos: Complex properties binding #37400
    community-contribution
  • Add cosmos db complex properties #37298
    community-contribution
  • Add parameterless overloads for AddPooledDbContextFactory<TContext> #37144
    community-contribution
  • Use port 8800 for Cosmos emulator on Helix #37110
  • Fix null check optimization for IQueryable/DbSet types in LINQ queries #36986
  • Align JSON and M.D.Sqlite representations #36951
    community-contribution
  • Add proper handling when a property’s backing field cannot be inferred or the unsafe accessor cannot be generated. #36720
    community-contribution
  • Implement MergeOption #36556
    community-contribution
  • Cleanup workaround around WriteXorExecute on Mac. #36243
  • Add a CreateSpanCollation method on SqliteConnection #36225
    community-contribution
  • Stop escaping Unicode characters unnecessarily in relational JSON #36166
  • Translate COALESCE as ISNULL in more cases #35986
    community-contribution
  • Add enum and comparison translators for cosmos #35405
    community-contribution
  • Add EF.Functions.JsonExists(expression, path) DbFunction #35389
    community-contribution
  • Translate to NULLIF #35327
  • Better cast/convert support for Cosmos #35000
    community-contribution
  • Lift try..catch out of an expression and replace with a temporary variable #34912
    community-contribution
  • Allow using foreign keys in Dataverse reverse engineering #34689
    community-contribution
  • Added Support for translating Array.IndexOf methods for byte arrays for SqlServer & SQLite #34457
    community-contribution
  • Avoid duplicating complex expression in comparisons #34172
    community-contribution
  • Prefer equality in boolean comparisons #34166
    community-contribution
  • Use null propagation to optimize away `IS NOT NULL` checks #34127

  • Implement `IS [NOT] DISTINCT FROM` translation #34048
    community-contribution
  • Translate x.parse #28337
    community-contribution
  • SQL Server: Support for full-text search TVFs (CONTAINSTABLE/FREETEXTTABLE) #37489

  • Add mechanism to clear ServiceProviderCache (#27189) #37487

  • Add Half type support for SQLite (#30931) #37481

  • Reverse processing order of setters in query generator #37323
